title: Uji Paku Kayu Keras & Buka Kardus Paku Cap Keris
hook: Paku murahan baru dihantam sekali langsung bengkok
story: Tukang kayu di bengkel menunjukkan paku murahan yang bengkok saat memaku kayu keras, lalu merekomendasikan Paku Cap Keris dari PT Intan Suar Kartika yang berstandar mutu ekspor dan anti bengkok.
caption: Pekerjaan konstruksi butuh material yang presisi dan tidak gampang bengkok. Paku Cap Keris hadir dengan jaminan timbangan pas 25 kg dan standar mutu ekspor. Komentar KATALOG untuk mendapatkan tautan WhatsApp pemesanan langsung lewat DM. #pakucapkeris #intansuarkartika #bahanbangunan #tukangkayu #proyekkonstruksi

creative.action: Menunjukkan paku bengkok lalu mengambil paku kokoh dari kardus Paku Cap Keris
creative.selection_reason: Menjawab keluhan nyata tukang proyek soal paku murahan gampang bengkok, membuktikan keunggulan baja mutu ekspor Paku Cap Keris PT Intan Suar Kartika.
creative.dialogue: Paku murahan baru dihantam sekali langsung bengkok? Waktunya beralih ke Paku Cap Keris dari PT Intan Suar Kartika! Baja murni standar mutu ekspor, dijamin lurus dan kokoh!

shots.prompt: Photorealistic live-action video, vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, one continuous shot. Medium shot in a woodworking workshop in bright morning natural daylight. An Indonesian male carpenter in a navy work shirt stands at his wooden workbench. On the workbench sits an open brown cardboard box of Paku Cap Keris matching the attached reference image, with clean bulk steel nails loose inside without plastic wrapping. In the first 3 seconds, he holds up a bent low-quality nail with a disappointed look, shakes his head and says, "Paku murahan baru dihantam sekali langsung bengkok? From 4 to 8 seconds, he tosses the bent nail away, picks up a sturdy straight steel nail from the Paku Cap Keris box, shows it confidently to the camera, points at its solid shank, and smiles with pride. From 8 to 10 seconds, he holds the clean nail ready against a thick wooden plank with his hammer raised. Natural Indonesian dialogue with clear lip sync and authentic workshop sound.
